title: Grieving Together, an otherWisdom Circle with Jungwon Kim
description: The second circle of otherWise’s Grief Cycle: a community dialogue on how grief lives between people, witnessing one another, mourning losses tied to a people or place, and making room for sorrow that does not resolve neatly. Grieving together as relationship, remembrance and care, rather than closure. Held by Jungwon Kim, a writer and cultural organiser who works with transgenerational grief and communal healing. Thursday 3 December 2026, 11am to 1pm Eastern (8am to 10am Pacific); See their page for how to join; Free, offered in the spirit of the gift. Offered by otherWise. Listed in the Relational River's Springs; join through the makers' own page.
